text: Cecilia Kass drugs her controlling partner, the optics engineer Adrian Griffin, and [escapes his secured house in the night|trigger|running from trouble]. Two weeks later he is reported dead by suicide and leaves her five million dollars, yet in the house where she hides she senses another presence. Doors open, her portfolio empties, a pill bottle reappears, and [everyone thinks she is paranoid|rules|no one believes you] as she becomes certain Adrian has used [an invisible bodysuit|origin|monsters people made] to [stalk and torment her|wants|power over others].
